candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeout as deepest error, but no redis-side metrics/logs confirm the cause of the timeout (e.g., saturation vs network).

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s transport errors to order; traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating through inventory (503) and order (502) to gateway checkout. Redis timeout is the best-supported root cause among the taxonomy.
